title: Sources: Nvidia's business development group, not its VC arm NVentures, has led much of its ~$90B dealmaking push across 145+ companies over the past 16 months (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Nvidia's business development group, not its VC arm NVentures, has led much of its ~$90B dealmaking push across 145+ companies over the past 16 months — Chipmaker's spending rivals Big Tech's biggest venture operations, tying customers and start-ups to its technology
